blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
The ways programs like this die — and the guard we ship against each:

items: PII escape
PII escape — entity-level redaction runs before inference and after generation, with sampling audits on live traffic
Silent prompt drift
Silent prompt drift — prompt changes ship through a signed registry with eval baselines, so a tweak can never quietly move behavior, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Ungrounded fluency
Ungrounded fluency — guarded because answers that read well but cite nothing are blocked at the fence — every claim carries a retrieval pointer or the response declines
